note: Real sale on production. The wallet UI sent 8.587415 USDT in one user operation (success true, paymaster 0x888888888888Ec68A58AB8094Cc1AD20Ba3D2402 paid actualGasCost 81854496527216100 wei, POL balance stayed 0); receipt status 1, block 97937958, one USDT Transfer of 8587415 base units from the wallet to the DFX deposit address 0x91bedD5b263eAe1D8973846317eF8FCDf73605E6. The backend found the hash on the first read (DFX transaction 350180, Sell, USDT, Polygon). The run then stopped red on its own check: the record returns inputAmount 8.5874, because the API rounds asset amounts to 5 significant digits (Util.roundReadable, roundByPrecision 5, ROUND_HALF_UP, API commit 159b090), while the check expected 8.587415 exactly. A separate read after the run showed state PayoutInProgress, outputAmount 7.69 EUR, at 2026-11-25T13:16:28Z; API commit 159b090 before and after. The run wrote no echter-lauf.json and took no explorer or app page screenshot, because those steps come after the failed check. Not repeated: no second sale.
